caption: The drawing depicts an architectural element, specifically a cast iron marquee cornice, as labeled in the lower right corner of the image. The cornice is detailed with ornate decorative patterns, including foliage motifs and crest-like forms along the top edge. The structure underneath the cornice appears to be part of a building entrance or window, with thick rectangular supporting columns that have layered bases and capitals. The illustration is executed in black ink with brown wash shading to highlight textures and shadows, particularly emphasizing the depth and three-dimensionality of the cornice and architectural details. Some sections of the door or window panels beneath the marquee are shown with parallel hatching for shading, while other architectural elements are delineated with simple outlines. Small leafy branches are visible extending from the right edge of the cornice. The background is plain and unadorned, with the hand-lettered text "CAST IRON MARQUE" and the added word "cornice" appearing in the lower right area of the drawing.
title: Cornice
